title: Balancing a Sentence
goal: Give a sentence balance and rhythm with parallel patterns.

items: I can balance a sentence with *no… sino…*, *tanto… como…* and *ni… ni…*.
I can mix long and short sentences to give a text rhythm.
I can tell a balanced sentence from an uneven one.
